scenes.name: Hook
scenes.label: 01 — THE QUESTION
scenes.text: You built this business with a partner. But if they suddenly passed away... who would own their shares?
scenes.display: You built this business with a partner. But if they suddenly passed away... who would own their shares?

scenes.name: OwnershipRisk
scenes.label: 02 — THE PROBLEM
scenes.text: Their shares may pass to their estate. You could end up sharing ownership with people who never planned to be involved. And their family may need cash, not shares.
scenes.display: Their shares may pass to their estate. You could end up sharing ownership with people who never planned to be involved. And their family may need cash, not shares.

scenes.name: Agreement
scenes.label: 03 — THE AGREEMENT
scenes.text: A buy-sell agreement sets out what happens when a specific event occurs: who can buy the shares, how the price is set, and the terms of the transfer.
scenes.display: A buy-sell agreement sets out what happens when a specific event occurs: who can buy the shares, how the price is set, and the terms of the transfer.

scenes.name: FundingGap
scenes.label: 04 — THE FUNDING PROBLEM
scenes.text: But here's what many business owners overlook: an agreement doesn't give you the cash to buy the shares.
scenes.display: But here's what many business owners overlook: an agreement doesn't give you the cash to buy the shares.

scenes.name: InsuranceSolution
scenes.label: 05 — THE FUNDING
scenes.text: Properly structured insurance can help fund the buyout, subject to policy terms, claims requirements, and how the arrangement is set up.
scenes.display: Properly structured insurance can help fund the buyout, subject to policy terms, claims requirements, and how the arrangement is set up.

scenes.name: CallToAction
scenes.label: 06 — NEXT STEP
scenes.text: If you share your business with other shareholders, don't leave succession to chance. Book a fifteen-minute shareholder continuity review.
scenes.display: If you share your business with other shareholders, don't leave succession to chance. Book a 15-minute shareholder continuity review.
